description: Before you connect to or trust an MCP server you found in a registry, use this to test it live and get a signed pass or fail. It runs 7 checks (answers, lists tools, valid names, descriptions, input schemas, no planted instructions, under 3 seconds) and returns a dated result for each. Free.

name: record_test
title: Test an MCP server live
